_comment: What players see under each prompt. 'example' is the most basic answer, shown as (e.g. …); it defaults to the prompt's first baseline answer. 'scope' is an optional one-line boundary with no answers in it. Notes inside prompt files are never shown. 'offtopic': true keeps a prompt out of the daily, Unlimited and packs; it stays in the Library as a practice-only extra. 'extra': true marks an on-topic prompt outside the IOAI syllabus: it stays out of the daily, challenges and live rooms, and joins a player's Unlimited and Quiz runs only when they switch on Extra questions in Settings. Off-topic prompts join those runs too when the switch is on. 'added': YYYY-MM-DD marks a prompt added after launch; dailies before that day never deal it, so adding prompts never changes a day already dealt.

accelerator.scope: A specific chip or accelerator line, not just a vendor

audio-feature.scope: Hand-crafted descriptors, transforms or learned embeddings of sound

calculus-concept.scope: A calculus or analysis idea, not an optimizer algorithm

classic-cv.scope: Hand-crafted vision from before deep learning, no CNNs

cv-metric.scope: Scores for boxes or masks, including speed and calibration

encoder-decoder-model.scope: An encoder feeding a decoder, not only text models

feature-selection.scope: Keeps a subset of the original features

fictional-ai.scope: From film, TV, books or games

ml-paper.scope: The title or the common name both count

ml-slang.scope: Community slang, not standard technical terms

nlp-metric.scope: Text generation, translation, ASR, QA, parsing or language models

nn-family.scope: Broad families, not specific named models

pandas-method.scope: Functions and methods, not plain attributes like shape

plot-type.scope: A named kind of plot, not a library or function

python-stdlib-module.scope: Ships with Python itself, no pip install

sklearn-utility.scope: Not a model or a plain transformer class

tabular-dataset.scope: Rows and columns or a synthetic toy set. No image, text or audio data

text-augmentation.scope: Creates extra or perturbed training text, not images

torch-nn-module.scope: Any class in torch.nn; the nn. prefix is optional

transformer-component.scope: A part of a transformer layer or the stack around it

ts-feature.scope: Features or transforms computed from a series or its timestamps

turing-award.scope: Any field of computing. Surname is enough
